summary: Completed frontend and integration testing for Purple Aster Studio. Found critical CORS configuration issue preventing authentication flow. Frontend UI is well-designed and functional for non-authenticated pages.

integration_issues.details: Kubernetes ingress/Cloudflare overriding backend CORS headers with wildcard '*' which conflicts with credentials mode
integration_issues.impact: Blocks entire authentication flow and all authenticated features

passed_tests: Homepage displays correctly with Purple Aster Studio branding
Login page displays with 3 role cards (client/admin/talent)
Role card descriptions are accurate and well-designed
Services page loads at /services with good design
Login redirects to Emergent Auth correctly
Protected routes redirect to /login when not authenticated
Navigation between public pages works correctly
Get a Quote button functionality works
UI design is professional and consistent
success_percentage: Frontend UI: 90% (public pages working), Backend Integration: 0% (CORS blocking all authenticated requests)
action_item_for_main_agent: CRITICAL: Fix CORS configuration issue. The Kubernetes ingress or Cloudflare is overriding backend CORS headers with wildcard '*' which prevents authenticated requests. Backend correctly configured for localhost:3000 but external URL returns wildcard. Need to configure ingress to preserve backend CORS headers or add proper CORS configuration at ingress level.
